items.basis: BNR board decision of 8 July 2026, read on economedia.ro; a search snippet says the 10 Aug 2026 meeting also held 6.50%
items.kind: central bank policy decision as reported by news (bnr.ro refused automated access)

items.basis: read on the CBRT policy-rate table
items.kind: central bank (CBRT one-week repo rate table)
items.scope: BENCHMARK ONLY: CBRT one-week repo (policy) rate, effective 23.10.2026 (cut from 37.00%). NOT the commercial loan rate
items.notes: NOT FOUND: CBRT weighted average TRY commercial loan rate. It is published only through EVDS, whose API requires a registered key ('Required request header key is not present'); the CBRT weekly-statistics page links only to EVDS. TRY commercial loans price well above the policy rate (a search-result dashboard put the average at ~40.9% around March 2026 — unverified, not used).

items.basis: 7.00% on every day of the latest H.15 week; DPRIME 7.00% since 17 Sep 2026 (6.75% before); Sep 2026 monthly average MPRIME 6.87%
items.kind: central bank (Federal Reserve H.15; daily series also read from FRED DPRIME https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=DPRIME)
items.scope: BENCHMARK: bank prime loan rate (H.15 note: 'one of several base rates used by banks to price short-term business loans'). The Survey of Terms of Business Lending (C&I loan rates) was discontinued in 2017
items.notes: A machinery loan to a mid-size manufacturer is typically prime ± a spread or SOFR + a spread; the prime rate is the benchmark only.

items.basis: 4.45% for the weeks of 14, 21 and 28 Oct 2026
items.kind: central bank (Bank of Canada Valet API, series V80691311 'Prime rate')
items.scope: BENCHMARK: chartered banks' prime rate (weekly)
items.notes: Bank of Canada also publishes the weekly effective business interest rate (BUSEFFRATE, https://www.bankofcanada.ca/valet/observations/BUSEFFRATE/json?recent=3): 4.67% for 23 Oct 2026 — a weighted rate on business borrowing (loans and bonds, outstanding), not new loans. No Bank of Canada series for new business loans was found.

items.kind: central bank (Banxico SIE table CF101)

items.notes: NOT FOUND: Banxico's average rate on new loans to firms. The SIE API needs a token ('Token inválido'), the SIE directory (sectors 18/19) has no corporate loan-rate table, and the July 2026 'Agregados monetarios y actividad financiera' release gives credit growth only.

notes: Key finance.corporate_loan = interest rate a manufacturer pays to finance machinery, % a year, local currency. Euro-area countries are in official/ecb-mir.json and are not repeated here.

True new-business NFC loan rates found for CZ, SE, RS, BR, JP (all borrowers, long-term), KR, TW (capital-expenditure loans), MA. Proxies: VN and ID (all new / all loans, central-bank data via secondary pages), MY and PH (outstanding-loan bases). Benchmarks only: US, CA, ZA, SG (prime); MX (TIIE 28); TR, RO, TH, TN, EG (policy / money-market rate — these understate the cost of a corporate loan, in TR and TH by several points).
Not reachable: www.bnr.ro (WAF), www.bi.go.id (empty reply), www.cbe.org.eg (Request Rejected); key-only APIs: CBRT EVDS, Banxico SIE, BOT.
Official layer: World Bank FR.INR.LEND is years stale for SE (2006) and UK (2014) and empty for TR; the RO 2025 value (8.52%) is the only annual RO lending rate available in this round.
